$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFOI (AIP France, chart dated 2022-10-06): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Abbeville

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

notes: TKOF or LDG is suspended if any glider is immobilized on the unpaved RWY within less than half RWY width from the common side.
During period of strong frost or after heavy rainfalls caution advised when using unpaved RWY.
Hotspot: multiple holding points in the vicinity indicated with ground markings and sign names.
Caution for unintentional RWY 13/31 penetration while taxing from paved RWY 02/20.
Aerobatics NR 6507 St Riquier Gapennes on 080°/ 5 NM.
Taxiing prohibited except on RWY and TWY.
